name: io.github.tethlo/mcp-for-cliniko
title: Tethlo MCP server for Cliniko (unofficial)
description: Unofficial. Cliniko for AI agents: patient lookup, diary, availability, bookings.

environmentVariables.name: CLINIKO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cliniko API key (My Info > Manage API keys).

environmentVariables.name: CLINIKO_CONTACT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your email, added to the User-Agent as Cliniko asks API clients to identify themselves.

environmentVariables.name: CLINIKO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override of the API base URL. Default: derived from the key, e.g. https://api.uk1.cliniko.com/v1
